questions.question:
Peter: Can you swim, Ben?
Ben: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 被『Yes, I am.』的口語習慣干擾，忘記助動詞 Can 必須與 can / can't 對應。
questions.scenario: At the park, Peter and Ben are talking about sports.
questions.explanation: 問句以 Can you...? 結尾，簡答時必須對應使用 can 或 can't，並且主詞要轉換為 I。選項 A 和 B 使用了錯誤的 Be 動詞或 do 助動詞。
options: Yes, I am. I can swim.
No, I don't. I can swim.
No, I can't. I can't swim.
Yes, you are. You can swim.

questions.question:
Emma: Look at the piano. Can you play the piano?
Leo: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 在簡答中誤將 can 替換為 am 或 don't。
questions.scenario: Emma is asking about Leo's talents for the school talent show.
questions.explanation: 問句是 Can you...?，正面回答需為 Yes, I can.。選項 B 誤用了 Be 動詞 am，選項 C 誤用了助動詞 don't。
options: No, I don't. I can't play the piano.
Yes, I can. I can play the piano.
Yes, I am. I can play the piano.
No, you can't. You can play the piano.

questions.question:
Anna: The bird is fast. Can it fly?
Sam: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞 (is) 與助動詞 (can) 混用。
questions.scenario: Two friends are watching a bird in the sky.
questions.explanation: 主詞是 it (the bird)，助動詞為 can，所以肯定回答必須是 Yes, it can.。
options: No, it isn't. It can't fly up high.
Yes, it can. It can fly up high.
Yes, it is. It can fly up high.
No, it doesn't. It can fly up high.

questions.question:
Teacher: Can you and Tim jump rope?
Student: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略了『you and Tim』是複數『你們』。
questions.scenario: During P.E. class, the teacher is asking the students about their skills.
questions.explanation: 問句中的主詞是 you and Tim (你們)，回答時必須切換為第一人稱複數 we (我們)，並且搭配助動詞 can。
options: Yes, we can. We can jump rope well.
No, we aren't. We can't jump rope well.
Yes, they are. They can jump rope well.
No, you don't. You can't jump rope well.

questions.question:
Jack: Your dog is very cute. Can he catch a ball?
Amy: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 未對齊問答中的助動詞 Can。
questions.scenario: Amy's dog is running super fast in the yard.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 he，助動詞 Can。選項 A 誤用 is，選項 B 誤用 does。選項 C 是正確的否定簡答。
options: Yes, he is. He can catch a ball.
No, he can't. He can't catch a ball.
Yes, he does. He can catch a ball.
No, it doesn't. It can catch a ball.

questions.question:
Lily: My grandpa is eighty years old.
Tom: Wow! ___________________
Lily: No, he can't.
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略回答中的 can't 提示而錯選 Is he 或 Does he。
questions.scenario: The children are talking about their grandfather's secret talent.
questions.explanation: 根據助理回答的 No, he can't. 反推問句必須以 Can 開頭。

questions.question:
Brother: Let's run by the pool!
Sister: No! You ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 將 Be 動詞否定與一般動詞直接堆疊。
questions.scenario: A brother and sister are playing by the swimming pool.
questions.explanation: 表達『不能』時應使用 can't。選項 B、D 使用 Be 動詞搭配原形動詞屬於嚴重文法錯誤。
options: aren't run by the clear pool.
doesn't run by the clear pool.
can't run by the clear pool.
isn't run by the clear pool.

questions.question: Which word has the /k/ sound like in 'can'?
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆字母 c 的 Hard /k/ 與 Soft /s/ 發音。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'c' and 'k' sound.
questions.explanation: can 的 c 發 /k/。kite 的 k 亦發 /k/。選項 B, C, D 的 c 發 /s/。

questions.question:
Mark: It's a nice monkey. Can it climb trees?
Sally: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 對助動詞 Can 提問回答 it is 或 it doesn't。
questions.scenario: Sally is drawing a picture of a cute monkey on the whiteboard.
questions.explanation: 問句主詞 it，助動詞 Can，肯定回答為 Yes, it can.。
options: No, it doesn't. it climb trees.
Yes, it is. It can climb trees.
Yes, it can. It can climb trees.
No, it isn't. It can't climb trees.

questions.question:
Mother: Can your friends ride a bike?
Daughter: ___________________
questions.commonMisconception: 將 your friends 誤認為 we，或是回答時錯用 Be 動詞。
questions.scenario: The mother is asking her daughter about her new friends from school.
questions.explanation: your friends 是複數，代名詞為 they。由 Can 提問，否定回答必須是 No, they can't.。
options: No, they aren't. They can't ride a bike.
Yes, we do. We can ride a bike.
Yes, they are. They can ride a bike.
No, they can't. They can't ride a bike.

questions.question:
A: Can you swim like a fish?
B: __________________. I am a good swimmer.
questions.commonMisconception: 反射性使用 I am 卻忽略問句是 Can。
questions.scenario: Talking about talents: Swimming.
questions.explanation: 良好泳者暗示肯定回答。選項 C 助動詞不符。

questions.question:
A: Look! A frog. Can it jump?
B: __________________. It can jump high.
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 Be 動詞與助動詞的簡答對應。
questions.scenario: Seeing a frog in the pond.
questions.explanation: 青蛙會跳是常識。對應 Can it 的正確簡答為 Yes, it can.。

questions.question: Which word has the same beginning sound as 'kite'?
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 k 在 n 前不發音 (Silent k)。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'k' sound.
questions.explanation: king 的 k 發 /k/，與 kite 相同。選項 C, D 的 k 在 n 前不發音。

questions.question:
Brother: __________________?
Sister: Yes, I can. Let's sing together.
questions.commonMisconception: 無法由簡答還原正確問句結構。
questions.scenario: A brother asking his sister for help.
questions.explanation: 根據回答『Yes, I can...』反推問句。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤。

questions.question: Which word has the /s/ sound (Soft c)?
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 c 在 e, i, y 前通常發軟音 /s/。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'c' soft sound.
questions.explanation: city 的 c 在 i 前發 /s/。其餘選項發 /k/。

questions.question:
A: Can the kitten climb the chair?
B: __________________. It is too small.
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略後半句的生理限制條件。
questions.scenario: Talking about a small kitten.
questions.explanation: 太小了 (too small) 導致無法爬上去。選項 C 助動詞不符。

questions.question:
A: Look! Can it fly fast?
B: __________________. It is a jet.
questions.commonMisconception: 見到 it is 就想選 Yes, it is 回答 Can it。
questions.scenario: Pointing at a plane in the sky.
questions.explanation: 噴射機 (jet) 飛很快。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。

questions.question: Which word has the /k/ sound at the END?
questions.commonMisconception: 無法辨識 ck 組合發出的單一 /k/ 音。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'k' at the end.
questions.explanation: duck 的 ck 發 /k/ 尾音。其餘選項無此發音。

questions.question:
A: __________________?
B: No, they can't. They can't dance well.
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略複數代名詞 they 的對應需求。
questions.scenario: Asking about a group of students.
questions.explanation: 由回答『No, they can't』反推問句。選項 B 人稱單數不符。

questions.question:
A: Can a pig fly?
B: __________________. It has no wings.
questions.commonMisconception: 常識判斷正確但代名詞與助動詞組合選錯。
questions.scenario: Identifying sounds of animals.
questions.explanation: 豬沒翅膀不會飛。選項 B 邏輯錯誤。

questions.question:
A: Can he jump?
B: __________________. He can't even walk.
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從『不會走』推論『不會跳』的能力階層。
questions.scenario: A girl is helping her baby brother.
questions.explanation: 連走路都不會，當然不會跳。選項 C 助動詞語法不符。

questions.question: In which word does 'c' sound like /k/?
questions.commonMisconception: 忽略 c 位於字尾或字中時的發音規律。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'c' mid-word.
questions.explanation: picnic 中的 c 全發 /k/。其餘選項均發軟音 /s/。

questions.question:
A: Can the big bear run?
B: __________________. It is very fast.
questions.commonMisconception: 主詞是 bear (it)，卻習慣性回答 Yes, I can。
questions.scenario: Talking about things in a storybook.
questions.explanation: 很跑很快，故選肯定。選項 C 人稱錯誤。

questions.question:
Child: Can I have a cookie?
Mom: No, you __________________. It's dinner time.
questions.commonMisconception: 在許可權限語境中錯用狀態否定語 (am not)。
questions.scenario: Asking for permission.
questions.explanation: 拒絕許可用 can't。其餘選項語法不符許可情境。

questions.question: Which word has the hard /k/ sound?
questions.commonMisconception: 看到 b 開頭就隨意選，忽略尾音差異。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Double letter sound.
questions.explanation: back 的 ck 組合發硬音 /k/。其餘選項無此發音。

questions.question:
A: Can it sing like a person?
B: __________________
questions.commonMisconception: 在科幻情境中迷失基本的助動詞對稱規則。
questions.scenario: Two students discussing a robotic dog.
questions.explanation: 機器狗會唱歌的可能性通常被否定。對應 Can it 的正確簡答。選項 B 助動詞錯配。

questions.question:
A: Can it jump now?
B: __________________. It is sleeping.
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合睡覺狀態推論活動能力的暫時缺失。
questions.scenario: Looking at a sleeping hamster.
questions.explanation: 睡覺時不能跳。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。

questions.question: The sound of 'c' in 'cool' is the same as in __________.
questions.commonMisconception: 不知道 c 在 a, o, u 前發硬音 /k/。
questions.scenario: Phonics: Letter 'c' before 'o'.
questions.explanation: cool 的 c 發 /k/。candy 亦同。其餘選項為軟音 /s/。

questions.question:
Coach: You are strong. Can you jump over the box?
Student: __________________. Watch me!
questions.commonMisconception: 被 Watch me 的自信語氣震懾而忘了檢查文法一致性。
questions.scenario: A coach encouraging a student.
questions.explanation: 『看我的』(Watch me) 暗示肯定回答。選項 C 助動詞錯誤。

questions.question: Elephants __________________ fly. They are too heavy.
questions.commonMisconception: 語意了解但錯選描述習慣的助動詞 don't。
questions.scenario: Identifying traits: Can elephants fly?
questions.explanation: 大象太重了不能飛。填入表示『不能』的助動詞。選項 C 描述慣常行為不合情境。
